title: Quarterly privileged access review
requirement: Privileged access must be reviewed and approved each quarter with unnecessary access revoked

title: Production change management
requirement: Production changes must show approval testing and implementation evidence

title: Backup restoration testing
requirement: Critical backups must be restored and recovery results documented

title: Third-party security review
requirement: Critical vendors must receive periodic security assessment and approval

title: Termination access revocation
requirement: Access for terminated users must be revoked within 24 hours and reviewed

title: Security log monitoring
requirement: Security logs must be monitored with alerting and defined retention
